purpose: Calculates/predicts the volume fraction of strain-induced martensite (F_m) as a function of plastic strain using the Olson-Cohen (OC) model for deformation-induced martensite transformation kinetics.
applicability_conditions: Applicable to strain-induced martensite transformation in the studied medium Mn lightweight steel with a banded microstructure; used with the assumption that martensite nucleation occurs randomly (n=2). Loading-direction-dependent strain distribution is accounted for by using the plastic strain of austenite.

symbols.meaning: constant closely related to the shear band formation rate and the SFE of austenite
